2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000030_VARSHAHNBIG
2.description: Indeed. This vessel now serves as a host for my eye.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000040_VARSHAHNBIG
3.description: I was aware that the alchemists were busy preparing something, but this...

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000050_NIDHANA
4.description: We couldn't well send you on such a perilous mission unprepared, Your Excellency.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000060_NIDHANA
5.description: We spared no effort in crafting the body, and I daresay you'll find it adept at wielding weapons and magicks both.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000070_NIDHANA
6.description: 'Twas our intent to present it to you sooner, but we could not bring ourselves to do so knowing we could yet improve it further. Pray forgive us...

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000080_VARSHAHNBIG
7.description: There is naught to forgive. I am grateful for this fine vessel, and shall put it to good use.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000090_VARSHAHNBIG
8.description: Again, I ask that you watch over Radz-at-Han in my absence. The dangers we go to face are great and many, and I fear I will be unable to give matters here due attention.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000100_VARSHAHNBIG
9.description: And in opening the voidgate, there is ever risk that voidsent will find their way into our world...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000110_NAHBDEEN
10.description: Rest assured we are more than prepared.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000120_NAHBDEEN
11.description: Our soldiers have been training under Master Estinien. On my honor, we will not suffer a single fiend to pass.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000130_NAHBDEEN
12.description: So think only of your mission, Varshahn.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000140_NAHBDEEN
13.description: Ah, but seeing as this is a different body, perhaps we should use a different name?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000150_VARSHAHNBIG
14.description: Nay, Varshahn shall suffice. Though I may have thus grown up, I am as ever a little brother to you all.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000160_NAHBDEEN
15.description: As you say, as you say. Go then, Varshahn, and best of luck!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000170_YSHTOLA
16.description: I have something for you as well.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000180_YSHTOLA
17.description: While you were gone, Urianger paid us a visit.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000190_YSHTOLA
18.description: As you may recall, he joined us on our foray into Alzadaal's Legacy in part to conduct research for the Loporrits.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000200_YSHTOLA
19.description: Research they were delighted to receive, and which has already inspired them to consider new ways to improve their own treasure vault.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000210_YSHTOLA
20.description: As a token of their gratitude, Livingway entrusted a familiar relic to Urianger...

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000220_YSHTOLA
21.description: Aye, the crystal which showed the way to Meteion.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000230_YSHTOLA
22.description: The Loporrits no longer have need of it, and thus saw fit to return it to us.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000240_YSHTOLA
23.description: Harboring the power of Light, it could well aid us in our mission in the void.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000250_YSHTOLA
24.description: And who better to bear Hydaelyn's gift than Her chosen champion?

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000260_VARSHAHNBIG
25.description: If there is nothing left to discuss, then let us depart. Our boat awaits us in Akyaali.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000270_VARSHAHNBIG
26.description: I shall now lift the seal.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000280_VARSHAHNBIG
27.description: In the name of Alzadaal III... I cast open this door unto the void!

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000300_YSHTOLA
29.description: It worked. We should have no trouble passing through a gate of that size.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000310_ESTINIEN
30.description: What can we expect to find after stepping through?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000320_VARSHAHNBIG
31.description: On my previous foray, I emerged in a castle swarming with voidsent.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000330_VARSHAHNBIG
32.description: I was hopelessly outnumbered and forced to turn back. But together, I am confident we can hold our own.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000340_VARSHAHNBIG
33.description: Upon our arrival, let us deal with any hostile entities and secure the area.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000350_VARSHAHNBIG
34.description: The command of our mission, I leave in your capable hands.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000360_VARSHAHNBIG
35.description: In the event of battle, I shall adapt my tactics to complement your own.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000370_YSHTOLA
36.description: Should we require healing, I can provide it. 'Twould be a welcome change of pace from my recent havoc wreaking.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000380_VARSHAHNBIG
37.description: Take heart, my friends, and have faith. We will brave this broken world and rescue my sister Azdaja!

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000390_EARTHMONOLITH
38.description: Ssso the gate <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103> open again. And delivered the most mouthwatering morselsss...

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000400_EARTHMONOLITH
39.description: I am Scarmiglione─archfiend of earth, and first of Golbez's circle of four!

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000410_EARTHMONOLITH
40.description: Sssuch pleasure I will take in delivering you unto your graves!

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000430_ESTINIEN
42.description: This Scarmiglione─he <hex:021A020203>knew<hex:021A020103> the gate had opened.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000440_YSHTOLA
43.description: And not for the first time. He and his brethren must keep watch over the portal.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000450_VARSHAHNBIG
44.description: As we do ours. But to unflinchingly consume a fellow voidsent...

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000460_VARSHAHNBIG
45.description: Like men, perhaps they form factions and fight amongst themselves.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000470_ESTINIEN
46.description: The question is, what will the minions do?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000480_ESTINIEN
47.description: Your mistress is no more, and the one who consumed her we slew in turn. Do you still mean to try us?

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000490_YSHTOLA
48.description: I expect some voidsent are more intelligent than others. Perhaps these ones simply do not understand our words.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000500_ESTINIEN
49.description: Hmph. Even beasts ought to understand strength.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000510_VARSHAHNBIG
50.description: There is much we do not know about voidsent. If we are to survive their world, 'twould be wise to learn their ways.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
52.description: Let's proceed with caution and pick up what we can.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
53.description: Don't overthink it─we'll improvise as we go along.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000520_VARSHAHNBIG
54.description: Sage advice, my friend. 'Tis reassuring to have one so experienced with us.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000530_VARSHAHNBIG
55.description: If that is your preferred approach, then very well. I shall defer to your adventurer's intuition.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000540_VARSHAHNBIG
56.description: I am here, Sister. Finally here. And I will find you─I swear it...

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
60.description: You're the voidsent bound to Zenos!

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
61.description: Didn't you fade away when Zenos fell?

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000570_YSHTOLA
62.description: I see it now. The bottomless darkness. The insatiable hunger. The aura was present when we faced him in Garlemald.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000580_ESTINIEN
63.description: How did it come to be here?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000590_YSHTOLA
64.description: When Zenos died, its connection to the Source was severed. It was forced to return to the void.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000600_VARSHAHNBIG
65.description: Zenos? The disgraced prince you yourself laid low?

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000610_YSHTOLA
66.description: I see it now. The bottomless darkness. The insatiable hunger. The aura was present when we faced him in Garlemald.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000620_YSHTOLA
67.description: When Zenos died, its connection to the Source was severed. It was forced to return to the void.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000640_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
69.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)Yes, that was his name. And you <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> the friend, are you not?

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000670_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
72.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)The light just now... Of course. And thus I am returned...

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000680_VARSHAHNBIG
73.description: What do you mean, “returned”? Who are you?

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000690_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
74.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)I was once bound to the man named Zenos.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000710_YSHTOLA
76.description: “Avatar” as in the voidsent servants of reapers.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000720_YSHTOLA
77.description: “Avatar” as in the voidsent servants of reapers.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000730_YSHTOLA
78.description: In the name of his hunt, Zenos took up that traditional Garlean art.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000740_YSHTOLA
79.description: And through it, he forged a covenant with a being of the void to lend him strength.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000750_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
80.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)“Covenant”? A curse, more like. He stole my power. There was no equity in the arrangement.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000760_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
81.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)My very essence was altered. Twisted into a tool to serve his desires.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000770_VARSHAHNBIG
82.description: Your previous appearance. This is your true form, then?

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000780_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
83.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)Perhaps. Perhaps not. What does it matter?

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000800_ESTINIEN
85.description: Regardless of your form, you are a voidsent by nature.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000810_ESTINIEN
86.description: So answer me this: are you our enemy too?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000820_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
87.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)In this world, only a fool would attempt to devour a stronger being.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000830_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
88.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)And though it was as an avatar, I lost to you once. I have no desire to lose again.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000850_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
90.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)Now, you will answer me a question.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000860_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
91.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)Zenos called you “friend.” That's what you are? A friend?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
94.description: Whatever Zenos may have said, I wasn't his friend.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
95.description: Not to you. At least, not yet.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000890_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
98.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)What is it? What is a friend?

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000910_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
100.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)This is where I belong. My home. This endless darkness you call the void...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000920_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
101.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)There was once light here, and it shone its warmth upon creation. The lands were green and the seas were blue. Life flourished.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000940_VARSHAHNBIG
103.description: It must have been a terrible war indeed...

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000950_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
104.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)It shattered the balance, causing Darkness to engulf the world.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000960_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
105.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)All life was transformed into monstrosities─voidsent.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000980_YSHTOLA
107.description: As Light begat sin eaters, Darkness begat voidsent.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_000990_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
108.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)The sun was driven from the sky as fleeting day yielded to endless night. In time, even land and sea lost their distinction.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001000_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
109.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)And though the spark of reason had died in us, driven by memory's shadow, we formed factions and carved out domains.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001010_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
110.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)This castle, for instance. Its erstwhile lord must have abided in such a place once upon a time.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001020_YSHTOLA
111.description: If I may... The Darkness in you is too much for any man to harbor; to my eyes, you are indeed a voidsent.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001030_YSHTOLA
112.description: Yet your knowledge of the past and your demeanor mark you apart from your brethren.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001040_YSHTOLA
113.description: You are different, that much is plain. But in what way, I am unsure.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001050_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
114.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)As you say, I am voidsent. But only in part.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001060_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
115.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)The Darkness touched my mother when the war had only just begun. When I was still in the womb.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001070_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
116.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)As a child, I looked like any other. But Darkness coursed through me, and I ceased to age when I'd become a woman grown.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
117.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)But that was then, and now...I may as well be one in full.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001090_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
118.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)I prey on the weak and serve the strong. I live to survive. Nothing more.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001100_YSHTOLA
119.description: Forgive me, 'twas not my intent to pry...

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001110_YSHTOLA
120.description: I realize, too, that I've neglected to ask your name.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001120_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
121.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)As we say “mortal,” you may call me “voidsent.”

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001130_VARSHAHNBIG
122.description: That is liable to cause confusion. If you are not averse, we would address you by your true name.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001140_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
123.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)Then call me what you will. I care not.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001160_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
125.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)Meaning “nothing”? A name as fitting as any.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001170_YSHTOLA
126.description: No, not “nothing,” but rather a “beginning.” For it remains to be seen what you will become to us.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001180_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
127.description: (-Dark-robed Voidsent-)As I said, I care not. Zero, then.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
130.description: I think it's a nice name.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001190_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
131.description: Partnership...? Are you saying you wish to strike a bargain?

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001200_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
132.description: A name is a string of sounds. Its meaning has no bearing on my nature.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001210_VARSHAHNBIG
133.description: Well, Zero. While there is no end to the questions we could ask, 'tis only fair that we tell you our purpose in coming here.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001220_VARSHAHNBIG
134.description: We are searching for a dragon, one who came to your world long ago.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001240_VARSHAHNBIG
136.description: Yes. Azdaja is her name, and she is my sister. If you have any knowledge of her, I beg you share it with us.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001280_YSHTOLA
140.description: I thought I heard a voice as well. The keening of voidsent, perhaps...

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001290_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
141.description: This place is as good as any. Let me have the aether now.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001330_EARTHMONOLITH
146.description: Ahhh, that I should miss my mark...

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001340_ESTINIEN
147.description: That fiend again? But we struck it down─watched it die!

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001350_EARTHMONOLITH
148.description: Fools. Death doesn't exissst in this world. And I─I am free to return whensoever I please.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001380_YSHTOLA
151.description: Of course. In the First, the power of Light─of passivity─prevents life from emerging in the Empty.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001390_YSHTOLA
152.description: But in the Thirteenth, the power of Darkness─of activity─prevents life from finding rest, even should soul be separated from flesh.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001400_VARSHAHNBIG
153.description: So unless one's essence is absorbed by another, 'tis possible to return again and again...

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001410_EARTHMONOLITH
154.description: Hm... Your aether─it is reminissscent of that creature's. Ahhh, my mouth waters at the memory...

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001430_EARTHMONOLITH
156.description: I must devour you too. Yes, I must!

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001440_EARTHMONOLITH
157.description: Ye drifting souls, by my power be reborn!

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001450_ESTINIEN
158.description: If it's another death they want, I say we give it to them.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001460_YSHTOLA
159.description: If you could lend us a hand, we'd be much obliged.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001470_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
160.description: That you would. But you already owe me a debt, and until you make good on it, I won't lift a finger.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001480_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
161.description: We'll speak after you have won. But know that if you lose, I'll help myself to your aether.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001490_EARTHMONOLITH
162.description: That a bothersome duty should deliver to me this lavish feassst...

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001500_EARTHMONOLITH
163.description: Come, struggle with all your might! It will make you that much richer and tastier!

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001510_EARTHMONOLITH
164.description: When will you learn? No matter what you do, you cannot hope to win.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001520_YSHTOLA
165.description: You never know until you try, and I'm always happy to experiment.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001530_ESTINIEN
166.description: Zero─is there no way to stop them from coming back?

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001540_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
167.description: There is. But I have no reason to share it with you.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001560_YSHTOLA
169.description: You know, Zero. You do owe us for one thing.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001580_YSHTOLA
171.description: You'll have your promised aether, but we are owed compensation for your name.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001590_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
172.description: A name for which I did not ask...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001600_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
173.description: But that I nevertheless did accept.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001630_ESTINIEN
176.description: Well now, that's quite the trick.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001660_VARSHAHNBIG
179.description: Come, my friends. With Zero's aid, we can defeat him!

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001670_EARTHMONOLITH
180.description: What is this!? What have you done!?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001680_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
181.description: Now that I think on it, you owe me a debt as well.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001690_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
182.description: You may have missed your mark...but I won't miss mine.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001710_EARTHMONOLITH
184.description: Fools! Do not think you have defeated me! I will return, again and again!

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001720_EARTHMONOLITH
185.description: What? My flesh... Why won't it heal? What is the meaning of thisss!?

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001740_EARTHMONOLITH
188.description: Memoria!? But how? How can you have this power?

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001750_EARTHMONOLITH
189.description: Death has no place in this world. We are beyond it...and yet...

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001760_EARTHMONOLITH
190.description: Ah, Lord Golbez! You have sent me to my doom!

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001770_EARTHMONOLITH
191.description: Curse you and your wretched flattery, and this abominable fate!

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001780_BLACKKNIGHT
192.description: (-Knight in Black-)You are well come, seekers of might.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001790_BLACKKNIGHT
193.description: I, Golbez, have called you four hither...

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001800_BLACKKNIGHT
194.description: I who would see us triumph in the coming crusade...

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001810_BLACKKNIGHT
195.description: That I may entrust you with command of our armies.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001820_WATERMONOLITH
196.description: (-Spirited Voidsent-)Yes, yes, but what of the promised gift?

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001830_EARTHMONOLITH
197.description: (-Shifty Voidsent-)In exchange for our loyalty, we are to feast on the finest aether.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001840_BLACKKNIGHT
198.description: And so you shall. For if you are to serve me, you must be strong.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001850_WINDMONOLITH
199.description: (-Alluring Voidsent-)Then honor the pact, and pray we are not disappointed.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001870_FIREMONOLITH
201.description: (-Dignified Voidsent-)The fiery wings, the savage horns...it pulses with life! Such vibrant aether!

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001880_FIREMONOLITH
202.description: (-Dignified Voidsent-)This magnificent creature could only come from beyond the veil.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001890_BLACKKNIGHT
203.description: Indeed. Feast, my friends. Feast, and arise as my four archfiends!

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001900_BLACKKNIGHT
204.description: As they are now, they can consume but a fraction of the dragon's aether.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001910_BLACKKNIGHT
205.description: Just as well. The creature may yet serve other ends.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001940_YSHTOLA
208.description: But it has been sealed away─transformed into crystal.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001960_VARSHAHNBIG
210.description: I take it they are connected to the war of which you spoke.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001970_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
211.description: Aye─their use was central to the Contramemoria, hence its name.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001980_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
212.description: And to my knowledge, the transformation is permanent.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_001990_VARSHAHNBIG
213.description: I see. We thank you for coming to our aid.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002000_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
214.description: I repaid a debt, and in doing so ensured that I receive my own due compensation. Which I shall have now.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002010_YSHTOLA
215.description: Yes, yes. I still have work to do, so I would thank you not to get carried away.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002020_ESTINIEN
216.description: Aether as the coin of choice. I appreciate the simplicity.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002040_YSHTOLA
218.description: That makes us even, I trust.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002050_YSHTOLA
219.description: Right, then─when you picked up the crystal, you experienced a vision, did you not?

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002060_VARSHAHNBIG
220.description: A dragon resembling a great wyrm? I dare to hope that it was Azdaja...

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002070_VARSHAHNBIG
221.description: Even as it pains me to think she has been made to suffer.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002080_ESTINIEN
222.description: For the ambitions of this Golbez...

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002090_YSHTOLA
223.description: We've been given much to consider. Let us a take a moment to review what we know.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002110_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
225.description: Good, it agrees to serve. Get on.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002140_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
228.description: In the beginning, it was a sanctuary for me alone.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002150_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
229.description: But over time, others began to gather here. Those who had nowhere else to go.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002200_VILLAGEVOIDSENTD
234.description: Let me have some! Let me have some!

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002240_VILLAGEVOIDSENTD
238.description: I-I don't want to be eaten!

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002250_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
239.description: You are under my protection here and will not be harmed. I give you my word.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002270_FIREMONOLITH
242.description: (-Throne of Fire-)Not only did the mortals conquer Troia─they defeated Scarmiglione?

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002280_FIREMONOLITH
243.description: (-Throne of Fire-)I struggle to believe it...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002290_SPYVOIDSENT
244.description: (-Spy's Voice-)There is more, my lords. They were aided by one of our world, who transformed Scarmiglione's soul into crystal!

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002300_FIREMONOLITH
245.description: (-Throne of Fire-)Crystal!? This one speaks of memoria!

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002310_WATERMONOLITH
246.description: (-Throne of Water-)Now there's a word I've not heard for an age. It'd bring a pang of nostalgia to my breast and a tear to my eye...

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002320_WATERMONOLITH
247.description: (-Throne of Water-)...If the very notion wasn't absurd! The gifted are gone, drowned in Darkness─as were we all!

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002330_BLACKKNIGHT
248.description: And yet Scarmiglione still does not answer.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002340_BLACKKNIGHT
249.description: Were he alive, he would have returned by now.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002350_BLACKKNIGHT
250.description: Weakest though he was, his ability to regenerate was without peer.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002370_BLACKKNIGHT
252.description: If this account is true─if a memoriate has survived...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002380_BLACKKNIGHT
253.description: They cannot be suffered to live.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002390_WINDMONOLITH
254.description: (-Throne of Wind-)Leave this matter to me, Lord Golbez.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002400_WINDMONOLITH
255.description: (-Barbariccia-)I, Barbariccia, shall strike down any who pose a threat to our plans.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002410_BLACKKNIGHT
256.description: 'Tis true you are a proven commander, well suited to leading an assault.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002420_WINDMONOLITH
257.description: (-Barbariccia-)And when I have succeeded, I would beg a boon of you.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002450_FIREMONOLITH
260.description: (-Throne of Fire-)The insolence! Know your place!

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002460_WINDMONOLITH
261.description: (-Barbariccia-)With respect, my locks are free as the wind. Without incentive to sway them, I know not whither they will blow.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002470_BLACKKNIGHT
262.description: Boldly spoken. I trust you will not disappoint me.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002480_WINDMONOLITH
263.description: (-Barbariccia-)Upon this flowing hair and my immortal soul, I will not fail.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002490_BLACKKNIGHT
264.description: Then go, and impress upon these interlopers the futility of defiance.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002530_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
268.description: And she's brought her domain with her.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002540_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
269.description: The archfiend's after you and yours, I shouldn't doubt.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002550_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
270.description: Perhaps you should go and find them. But be warned─whatever this is about, do not expect us to get involved.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002560_FORMERMINIONVOIDSENT
271.description: I can't bear it... Eating and being eaten... I only want to be left in peace...

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002590_YSHTOLA
274.description: They must have been tracking our movements.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002610_WINDMONOLITH
276.description: Excellent. You've saved me the trouble of traveling to Troia.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002630_WINDMONOLITH
278.description: Mind your manners, mortal! My name is not to be spoken save in reverence and fear.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002640_WINDMONOLITH
279.description: And what is this pitiful domain?

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002650_WINDMONOLITH
280.description: Pitiful wretches all. I will put you out of your misery!

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002660_WINDMONOLITH
281.description: Alas, poor Scarmiglione, and good riddance. Felled by outsiders in pursuit of what, pray tell?

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002670_VARSHAHNBIG
282.description: A dragon─one who crossed to this world thousands of years ago. Know you aught of it?

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002700_WINDMONOLITH
285.description: My Lord Golbez is more clever than I realized. To let the prize live that it might lure more prey to us.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002710_WINDMONOLITH
286.description: Very well. In gratitude and service, I shall devour every last mote of their souls.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002720_VARSHAHNBIG
287.description: Where is she? Where is Azdaja!?

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002730_WINDMONOLITH
288.description: Heh, you even share its scent. How curious...and irresistible!

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002750_ESTINIEN
290.description: If you think us easy prey, you're wrong.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002760_WINDMONOLITH
291.description: Unlike Scarmiglione, I need not skulk in shadow to claim what is mine.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002770_WINDMONOLITH
292.description: If you would know about the dragon you seek, then enter into my domain.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002780_WINDMONOLITH
293.description: You may flee instead if you wish─if the fate of the sorry lot here is of no concern to you. One way or another, I will have satisfaction.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
297.description: If we go, we'd be playing into her hands.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002800_VARSHAHNBIG
298.description: Indeed. Yet she will have the upper hand in her domain. We must be no less than fully prepared.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002810_ESTINIEN
299.description: Aye, that we would. Even so, we don't have any intention of turning tail now, do we?

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002820_ESTINIEN
300.description: We find her and get our answers. Will you be joining us, Zero?

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002830_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
301.description: You may be easily goaded into accepting her challenge, but my curiosity is not so insatiable as to cloud my judgment.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002840_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
302.description: Nevertheless, if you are desperate for my aid...you know my price.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002860_VARSHAHNBIG
304.description: So long as you leave me strength enough to see my sister home, you may take as much as you wish.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002870_VARSHAHNBIG
305.description: And lest you forget, mine is no ordinary aether. Barbariccia too recognized its potency.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002890_ESTINIEN
307.description: You're not the only ones who can ride the wind!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002930_WINDMONOLITH
311.description: Come! Give yourselves to my scouring winds that I may feast upon your essence!

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002940_WINDMONOLITH
312.description: No... I will not be denied...

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002950_WINDMONOLITH
313.description: There's still time... With more of the dragon's aether, I can yet...

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_002990_YSHTOLA
317.description: I see you've bested Barbariccia. Well done.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003000_ESTINIEN
318.description: Her minions, too, are all crystallized or scattered. The day is ours.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003010_VARSHAHNBIG
319.description: What of my sister? Tell me you learned something about Azdaja!

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003020_VARSHAHNBIG
320.description: So the archfiend and her crystal yielded naught...

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003030_ESTINIEN
321.description: Our efforts have not been entirely fruitless.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003040_ESTINIEN
322.description: We have deprived your sister's captor of another powerful champion. With Zero, we may yet challenge Golbez and his minions.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003050_VARSHAHNBIG
323.description: Indeed, we could not have come this far without your aid. Thank you, Zero.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003060_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
324.description: I but fulfilled my part of the bargain. And now I will have my...my...

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003080_YSHTOLA
326.description: Her aether is nearly spent. Perhaps unsurprising given how much power she used.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003090_ESTINIEN
327.description: I wouldn't want to face another archfiend without her. We should hurry back to Zero's domain.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003100_VARSHAHNBIG
328.description: Agreed. Eager though I am to continue, 'twould be unwise to risk our lives for the sake of haste.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003110_VARSHAHNBIG
329.description: Let us suspend the mission and tend to Zero.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003120_NAHBDEEN
330.description: Ahhh, you're all safe! Thank the Sisters!

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003130_VARSHAHNBIG
331.description: A moment while I close the gate.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003140_VARSHAHNBIG
332.description: ...There. We may rest easy for now.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003150_VARSHAHNBIG
333.description: Was there any trouble? I expect some voidsent slipped through...

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003160_NAHBDEEN
334.description: A few did, aye, but we were ready and dealt with them without incident.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003170_VARSHAHNBIG
335.description: That is well. I cannot thank you enough for your vigilance.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003180_NAHBDEEN
336.description: Yes, yes, you're grateful. But aren't you forgetting something more important?

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003190_NAHBDEEN
337.description: You know...the polite-but-warm formalities one delights in hearing when their little brother returns from a long journey.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003205_VARSHAHNBIG
339.description: Ahem. It is good to be home again, among those whom I love dearly and missed so much.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003210_NAHBDEEN
340.description: And we are glad to receive you, Varshahn! Welcome home!

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003220_VARSHAHNBIG
341.description: Chambers have been prepared for your use at Meghaduta. Let us take Zero there at once.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003230_VARSHAHNBIG
342.description: Our mission took many an unexpected turn. I am relieved that we have all returned safely.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003240_VARSHAHNBIG
343.description: But before you all enjoy the rest you have earned a dozen times over, I would consult you on one last matter.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003260_VARSHAHNBIG
345.description: While she appears none the worse for wear, she remains locked in slumber, and I cannot help but worry.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003270_VARSHAHNBIG
346.description: Is there aught we can do to expedite her recovery? If her aether is exhausted, perhaps I can share some of mine now...

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003280_YSHTOLA
347.description: In the wastelands of the Thirteenth, one can only replenish aether by taking it from others, be it by trade or by force.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003290_YSHTOLA
348.description: In contrast, the Source is rich in ambient aether.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003300_YSHTOLA
349.description: Simply being here and drawing breath, Zero will absorb what she needs.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003330_YSHTOLA
352.description: She will awaken in time, and when she does, give her something to eat. Judging by her form, she should also be able to derive nourishment from food.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003340_YSHTOLA
353.description: I know you promised her your aether, but perhaps she might appreciate fine Hannish cuisine more.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003360_ESTINIEN
355.description: She looks like any other person. Unsurprising, perhaps, given that she is only part voidsent.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003370_YSHTOLA
356.description: Zero said before that Zenos had altered her essence.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003380_YSHTOLA
357.description: A change wrought, I suspect, with the power of Darkness. It acted upon the part of her that is voidsent, rendering it dominant. Thus we were able to reverse it with the power of Light.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003390_YSHTOLA
358.description: I labor to believe that Zenos possessed such arcane knowledge. In all likelihood, it came from Fandaniel.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003400_YSHTOLA
359.description: Were Zero wholly voidsent, I doubt the crystal would have had an effect on her.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003410_YSHTOLA
360.description: One might say that Hydaelyn had a hand in your meeting.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003420_VARSHAHNBIG
361.description: 'Tis no exaggeration to say that Zero has proven herself invaluable─a boon from Hydaelyn Herself.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003430_VARSHAHNBIG
362.description: Her cooperation may come at a price, but whatever it is, I am willing to pay it. Exhausting though it may be at times.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003450_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
364.description: Is this...an inn? What happened? How did I get here?

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003460_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
365.description: There's no time. I must rejoin the battle. I must...

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003500_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
369.description: What is this!? Some sort of fiend!?

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003510_NIDHANA
370.description: A fiend!? Where is it!? Where!?

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003520_NIDHANA
371.description: Ack, but this is no time for jokes...

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003530_NIDHANA
372.description: You're in the Source, my dear─the world next door, so to speak. The others brought you here after you collapsed.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003540_NIDHANA
373.description: I'll fetch them at once. Wait just a moment!

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003550_VARSHAHN
374.description: I took the liberty of arranging refreshments. I hope you find them as flavorful as they are invigorating.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003560_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
375.description: This isn't what you promised. But I suppose aether is aether...

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003570_NIDHANA
376.description: Wait, wait, wait! Don't tell me you don't know how to eat?

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003580_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
377.description: I took what I needed from it. What's the problem?

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003590_NIDHANA
378.description: Where's the enjoyment in that? You're supposed to bite, to chew, to savor, and then swallow!

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003610_NIDHANA
380.description: That's the way! So...did it taste good?

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003630_YSHTOLA
382.description: The long years without eating may have dulled your sense of taste.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003640_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
383.description: Well, we voidsent have no need for such when consuming others.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003650_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
384.description: There are some who speak of “taste” when describing the quality and affinity of their prey's aether...

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003660_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
385.description: But I loathe the act. Taking aether in small amounts like this is one thing, but diluting my essence─diminishing myself? I'd sooner die.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003670_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
386.description: And I have died. Countless times.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003680_NIDHANA
387.description: You have? Um...but what happens when you do?

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003690_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
388.description: Not much. After a while, you return, together with all your expended life force.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003700_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
389.description: The important thing is to die where others won't devour you.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003710_NIDHANA
390.description: Amazing! My peers who study immortality and resurrection would be most interested in this phenomenon!

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003720_VARSHAHN
391.description: The question of taste aside, I am glad that you are able to partake of food like us. I daresay it agrees with your personal preferences.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003730_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
392.description: That's true. You can keep giving me the same on a regular basis.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003740_VARSHAHN
393.description: Very well. As my guest, I shall see that you do not want for comfort.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003760_VARSHAHN
395.description: We brought you to our world without your consent, and for that I apologize. If you wish it, we will return you to yours once you have regained your strength.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003770_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
396.description: ...It's fine. I have no reason to go back.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003780_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
397.description: ...Except for yours, perhaps. You intend to cross over again, I take it?

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003790_VARSHAHN
398.description: I do. I have yet to find my sister.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003800_VARSHAHN
399.description: I want nothing more than to rush to her aid─to find this Golbez and free her from his clutches, if he still holds her captive.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003810_YSHTOLA
400.description: Though if our recent experience has taught us anything, 'tis that the Thirteenth is more dangerous than we ever imagined. Caution must be our watchword.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003820_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
401.description: Better late than never. In the short time you spent in our world, you left a trail of chaos in your wake.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003830_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
402.description: You managed to return in one piece this time, but don't assume you'll be so lucky the next.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003840_VARSHAHN
403.description: Rest assured we will make no assumptions and spare no preparation.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003850_VARSHAHN
404.description: Speaking of which, while we rest and ready ourselves, I ask that you tell me more about your home.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003860_VARSHAHN
405.description: In return, I will tell you about ours. I will show you my domain, Radz-at-Han.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003870_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
406.description: Again a stranger in this strange land...

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003880_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
407.description: I have a condition. You must come too.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003900_VARSHAHN
409.description: So, what are your impressions of Radz-at-Han?

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003920_VARSHAHN
411.description: Considering your origin, I can see why that might be your first observation. Though they would call each other “people,” I think.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003930_VARSHAHN
412.description: If you wish to know about our fair city, I should be glad to place a guide at your disposal.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003940_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
413.description: No need─I'll show myself around. There's only so much about my home I can share with you in return, after all.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003950_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
414.description: While I remember some few tales of the past, I cannot speak to their authenticity.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003960_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
415.description: But if that is enough, then I will tell you of the events that saw Darkness engulf our world─the Contramemoria.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003980_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
417.description: Long ago, Light filled the world, and all was at peace.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_003990_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
418.description: But then the servants of Darkness came, and they bequeathed a black art unto men.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004000_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
419.description: Channeling the power of hope and prayer, one could call forth fearsome beings known as eidolons.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004010_YSHTOLA
420.description: The Ascians. And these eidolons are surely primals.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004020_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
421.description: Then you have faced the same, and understand that when an eidolon is birthed, strife follows. And in such strife, the weak are first to suffer.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004030_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
422.description: When it seemed the world would be plunged into chaos, heroes appeared─they who were blessed with a singular power.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004040_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
423.description: The power to bind the aether of eidolons within crystals known as memoria.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004050_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
424.description: My mother was one such memoriate. But in fighting to save many, she herself was touched by Darkness─as was I.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004060_YSHTOLA
425.description: And so you were born part voidsent. Before the world was overcome?

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004070_VARSHAHN
426.description: How exactly did that calamity come to pass? Did the memoriates not triumph?

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004080_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
427.description: They did. They expunged the seeds of chaos and restored the peace...only to find themselves seduced by the Darkness they had sealed.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004090_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
428.description: They spread the taint, transforming men into monsters─what you call voidsent─and raised armies to wage new wars.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004100_ESTINIEN
429.description: Not the first to be corrupted by power─nor the last.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004110_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
430.description: Some defied temptation and held fast to the Light, my mother and I among them.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004120_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
431.description: For years and years we fought, but it was not enough. And when our strength was spent, our bulwarks broken, so too was the world.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004140_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
433.description: The stars faded from the heavens as a pall black as pitch enveloped creation. Darkness raged unchecked, rending the very walls of reality.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004150_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
434.description: I was cast into the rift, and there trapped for what felt like an eternity.

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004160_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
435.description: Until I came upon a crack. Tiny, infinitesimal─but enough for me to squeeze through...

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004170_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
436.description: ...And find my world changed beyond recognition. Into the lightless waste you saw.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004180_VARSHAHN
437.description: So that is how you were able to escape becoming a voidsent in full.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004190_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
438.description: I suppose I should consider myself fortunate. Were I like most others, I wouldn't have lasted a day before being devoured.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004200_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
439.description: We the lost are better equipped to survive in a lost world.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004220_YSHTOLA
441.description: I wouldn't be so sure. The Thirteenth is still there, is it not?

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004240_YSHTOLA
443.description: To explain requires that we initiate you into the truth of the Source and its reflections. Be warned that this will take a while...

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004250_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
444.description: Then...unlike the worlds that have been rejoined, mine still...

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004260_YSHTOLA
445.description: The Oracle of Light prevented the First from being completely overcome, so the situation may not be completely identical to that of your Thirteenth.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004270_YSHTOLA
446.description: But the fact remains that we were able to restore a measure of balance to a world brought to the brink of destruction.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004280_YSHTOLA
447.description: After which, some intrepid young souls succeeded in restoring life back to lands thought lost to Light.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004290_YSHTOLA
448.description: Which gives me cause to hope the day may yet come when life springs forth anew in the Thirteenth.

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004300_YSHTOLA
449.description: Which gives me cause to hope there may be a way to restore Light and life to the Thirteenth.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004310_YSHTOLA
450.description: Of course, these are only possibilities. I offer no guarantees.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004320_YSHTOLA
451.description: But having experienced what we have, I daresay we are more qualified than most to speak on the matter.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004330_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
452.description: Wait, I don't understand. Why would you say these things? As if you mean to...

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004335_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
453.description: But the sole reason you came to the void was...

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004340_ESTINIEN
454.description: To find a dragon, aye. And in light of what we've seen, we'd be fools to strive for more.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004350_ESTINIEN
455.description: But we Scions─former Scions, begging your pardon─have a habit of not leaving well enough alone.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004360_ESTINIEN
456.description: And old habits die hard, don't they, my friend?

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004370_VARSHAHN
457.description: Restoring the Light would serve our efforts to find and free Azdaja. There is no reason not to try.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004380_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
458.description: ...Do as you will. I have no desire to save that world.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004390_VARSHAHN
459.description: Be that as it may, we will have need of your power when next we face voidsent.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004410_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
461.description: You know how it works. If you want my help, you must pay my price.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004420_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
462.description: And now that you've drawn Golbez's attention, it's going to cost you more. A lot more.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004430_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
463.description: I will consider this a deposit.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004440_BLACKKNIGHT
465.description: First Scarmiglione, and now Barbariccia... Useless, the both of them.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004450_FIREMONOLITH
466.description: (-Throne of Fire-)'Twas no lie─they conspire with a memoriate.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004460_BLACKKNIGHT
467.description: And their search for the dragon will lead them here.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004470_BLACKKNIGHT
468.description: The war looms nigh. We cannot allow these interlopers to interfere.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004480_FIREMONOLITH
469.description: (-Throne of Fire-)If I may, my lord, I have a plan to eliminate them.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004490_FIREMONOLITH
470.description: (-Throne of Fire-)In order to guarantee its success, however, I will require Cagnazzo's cooperation.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004500_WATERMONOLITH
471.description: (-Cagnazzo-)If there's sport to be had, then I'll play along. As much as I dislike following your lead, I have no patience for scheming.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004510_BLACKKNIGHT
472.description: Well and good to have confidence, but do not forget the cost of failure.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004520_FIREMONOLITH
473.description: (-Throne of Fire-)Rest assured I will see the dream to fruition. Even should I be consumed by my own flames, I will pave the way for one and all.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004530_BLACKKNIGHT
474.description: Then I will trust in your oath and your plan.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004540_FIREMONOLITH
475.description: (-Throne of Fire-)We will give you cause to rejoice, my lord. This I vow.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004550_WATERMONOLITH
476.description: (-Cagnazzo-)Heh heh, some excitement for a change!

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004560_BLACKKNIGHT
477.description: No sacrifice is too great. Even should my four archfiends be lost, I will not halt my steps.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004580_BLACKKNIGHT
478.description: The prison of passivity is an obstacle to my cause. And so you must fall.

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004590_BLACKKNIGHT
479.description: What irony that the blessed damned should set us free!

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004570_BLACKKNIGHT
480.description: As I swore so long ago.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06200_004600_BLACKKNIGHT
481.description: The gate lies open. At long last, my ambition shall be fulfilled!
